bugs.bug: nvm_get_download_slug falls back to x64 on Apple silicon only for versions below 14.17.0 or between 15.0.0 and 16.0.0, so versions 14.17.0 to 14.x and 15.x ... end up requesting non-existent arm64 darwin binaries
bugs.example: nvm.sh: the condition `version < 14.17.0 || (15.0.0 <= version < 16.0.0)` leaves 14.17.x-14.x on arm64, so macOS arm64 downloads of those versions request a binary that does not exist instead of falling back to x64
